chunks: Abu Basir narrated from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
"If a man separates the zakat from his wealth and designates it for a group of people, but it is lost, or he sends it to them and it is lost, then there is nothing upon him."

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: the obligatory alms-tax due from one’s wealth
key_terms.سَمَّاهَا: he designated or specified it for certain recipients
key_terms.فَضَاعَتْ: it was lost or went missing
key_terms.فَلَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no liability or obligation upon him
key_terms.لِقَوْمٍ: for a group of people intended to receive it
key_terms.مَالِهِ: his property or wealth from which zakat is paid

ai.seo_question: If separated zakat is lost before it reaches the recipients, must it be paid again?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning zakat that has already been separated from one’s wealth and designated for eligible recipients. If it is then lost, whether before delivery or during transmission, the payer bears no further liability.
